status: frozen before new price-rule fits or cost profiles
unit: one-step listing price forecast using strictly earlier retained observations; evaluation only consecutive calendar days
families: competitor offset with historical price limits and scheduled review
markdown after elapsed time since observed price change
recent category sales thresholds with cooldown
selection: Select within each family by October mean absolute price error, equally weighting seller-category-days. Also retain a separately labeled selector giving equal total weight to changed and unchanged observations. No test-data or cost-bound tuning.
price_grid: integer ask, displayed ceil(1.03*ask); broad implementation limits displayed approximately 10 to 2000, not a cost support restriction
cost_plan: Freeze policy predictions before loading demand or computing cost bounds. Evaluate fixed-demand linear profit-comparison constraints with persistent listing costs, first nonnegative with no finite upper cap, then the separately labeled no-below-observed-receipt restriction. No narrow within-category cost span. Compute all predeclared regret budgets and a feasibility frontier; do not call these confidence intervals.
additional_benchmarks: uniform previous-ask changes of -10,-5,+5,+10 dollars, known before current choice; no current-profit oracle
limitations: Daily snapshots do not establish timing, exogeneity, or software adoption. Sales history uses maintained terminal-sale assignment. One-step forecasts do not simulate alternative future inventory paths. Theory and first-stage uncertainty assessed separately.
